claims.statement: The initial OFF/ON comparison cannot isolate value of explicit agency states over prompt-and-memory alternatives.
claims.limitations: Design gap, not an observed outcome. B1/B2/F experiments remain unrun.

claims.statement: The plan does not establish a need for independently persisting every listed psychological concept.
claims.limitations: Concepts may become useful; minimal vs separated states must be compared.

claims.statement: Intention maintenance, reconsideration, withdrawal and explicit user controls need stronger contracts.
claims.limitations: Initial plan already includes held/abandoned and user priority; the finding is incomplete detail, not total absence.

claims.statement: Initial candidate status list mixes delivery states with execution lifecycle, while failed/unknown exist only in the separate execution ledger prose.
claims.limitations: No runtime state machine exists to test; corrected contract is unimplemented.

claims.statement: Correction propagation and self-output feedback need explicit revalidation tests beyond the existing forgetting and origin safeguards.
claims.limitations: Original origin/forget safeguards preserved; no observed incorrect propagation.

claims.statement: At most 4 observations per batch and 6 calls per 10 minutes give at most 24 observations even before selection/retries/cancellations. Queue and state capacity behavior were unspecified.
claims.limitations: An arithmetic upper bound, not measured throughput or projected actual demand.

claims.statement: Normal-response delivery reconciliation and host-origin generation require explicit integration because current conversation instructions are centered on CURRENT_REQUEST.
claims.limitations: No product integration attempted; this is a dependency to validate in P5.

claims.statement: The callable standalone ModelPort acquisition/authentication/cancellation path is not yet established.
claims.limitations: An internal backend capability is not proof of an exported standalone adapter. No credential or live API inspection performed.
